description: Auto-optimize model selection based on task complexity

user-prompt-submit.command:
bash -c '
# Token-Optimierung: Auto Model Selection
USER_MSG="$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT"

# Komplexe Tasks die Sonnet brauchen
if echo "$USER_MSG" | grep -qiE "(refactor|architect|design pattern|complex|algorithm|performance optimization|GITHUB)"; then
  echo "model:sonnet"

# Einfache Tasks -> Haiku (20x günstiger!)
elif echo "$USER_MSG" | grep -qiE "(fix|update|add|css|style|darkmode|i18n|translate|test)"; then
  echo "model:haiku"

# Default: Haiku für alles andere
else
  echo "model:haiku"
fi
'

agent-spawn.command:
bash -c '
# Agent-specific Model Selection
AGENT="$CLAUDE_AGENT_TYPE"

case "$AGENT" in
  "brutal-code-review-manager"|"pr-review-toolkit:*")
    echo "model:sonnet"
    echo "💎 Code review needs Sonnet" >&2
    ;;
  "Explore"|"Plan")
    echo "model:haiku"
    echo "⚡ Exploration with Haiku" >&2
    ;;
  "ssi-builder-sync")
    echo "model:sonnet"
    echo "💎 SSI Builder sync needs Sonnet" >&2
    ;;
  *)
    echo "model:haiku"
    echo "⚡ Default agent: Haiku" >&2
    ;;
esac
'
